content.text: On July 13, 1985, approximately two billion people watched the performances of acts like Queen, Madonna, Paul McCartney, David Bowie, Tina Turner, and U2 at Live Aid, which aimed to raise funds for famine relief in Ethiopia, alongside the live audience present at the event.
Forty years after the iconic Live Aid concert, the memories of that extraordinary day continue to thrive for a lucky few who managed to obtain a golden ticket.
The infamous group image of all the artists who performed at Live Aid in 1985, as captured by celebrity photographer Brian Aris.
